name: event-calendar
title: Event calendar
about:
Adds events to your site: event lists and calendar views for the page builder, a details card with add-to-calendar links, calendar feeds visitors can subscribe to, and Event structured data for search engines.
Setup: installing creates the Calendar event, Venue, Organizer, Series and Category content types, so there is nothing to paste. An older event type from version 0.1 keeps working. Each event needs a start time, and only published events are used. Needs a Hatamoto core with plugin SDK 0.28.1 or later.
Widgets: Event details, a calendar with list, month, week, day, photo, summary and map views, a mini calendar, an event countdown, a featured venue and a map of venues. The calendar filters by tag and by fields you opt in. Events can repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, and the Repeating tab has Skip, Change time and Restore buttons for single dates.
Maps use OpenStreetMap and are off by default. Turning them on looks up venue addresses and loads map tiles in the visitor's browser.
Imports: Google, Outlook, Meetup and iCal calendars, and Eventbrite organizations by API token. Sources set to daily are read twice a day and publish new events on their own once the owner approves the standing rule, at most 100 new events per run and 200 a day. Run now imports are drafts for your review. Visitors can also send in events through a form, off by default.
Set time_zone to your site's zone, for example Europe/London. No tickets or payments, only a ticket link.
features: Calendar widget with list, month, week, day, photo, summary and map views
Event details card with Google, Outlook, Yahoo and iCal links
Recurring events with Skip, Change time and Restore buttons
Tag and custom-field filters, with fields the owner opts in
Venue, organizer and series pages, mini calendar and countdown
Scheduled imports twice a day, published after the owner approves the rule
Eventbrite organization import by API token, past the old 100-event limit
Public event submissions and Run now imports, both reviewed by the owner
